beats.say: More oil moves through this channel than anywhere else on Earth.
beats.title: THE BUSIEST OIL ROUTE ON EARTH

beats.say: This is the Strait of Malacca, between Malaysia and the Indonesian island of Sumatra.
Around twenty three million barrels of oil a day pass through it, more than the Strait of Hormuz.
Most of it is heading to China, Japan and South Korea, the oil coming from the Middle East.
Near Singapore, the main channel narrows to under three kilometers.
That's why tiny Singapore became one of the richest port cities in the world.
Three kilometers between Asia's factories and their fuel. Follow for more.
beats.title: 3 KM THAT FUEL ASIA
